verdict.rationale: Self-serve restore is documented. There is an 'Instant restore' docs page, an API restore flow that keeps the connection string via `finalize_restore: true`, and MCP tools to restore branches, finalize restores from snapshots and recover deleted projects. Scheduled backups appear only as a 'schedule' snapshot tool in the MCP tool list and a general note that snapshots capture versions. Missing for 10: documented automatic backup schedules a founder can view and configure (e.g., console UI, frequency and retention settings), detail beyond page titles on restore windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of backup and restore.
